CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.owner_work_never_blocks_handoff()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  -- V2 rule: homeowner decisions and Active Owner work never block handoff.
  IF coalesce(NEW.requires_owner_approval,false)
     OR coalesce(NEW.tags,'{}'::text[]) @> ARRAY['active_owner'] THEN
    NEW.blocks_handoff := false;
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.onboarding_assignment_staff(_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(public.is_onboarding_staff(_actor),false) AND EXISTS(
  SELECT 1 FROM auth.users u WHERE u.id=_actor AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
   AND (u.banned_until IS NULL OR u.banned_until<=now()))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.can_assign_onboarding_responsibility(_actor uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT _actor IS NOT NULL AND private.onboarding_assignment_staff(_actor)
 AND (coalesce(public.has_role(_actor,'admin'),false) OR _actor=private.current_onboarding_director())
$function$
